title: Hearty Briny Indian Lamb Rogan Josh
description: A dense and flavorful Indian dish from Kerala featuring lamb, nectarines, and a blend of spices, cooked in a bain-marie for tender and juicy results.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the nectarines, garam masala, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the nectarines are caramelized.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
